steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0106_long_pdnd_nsga2_300gen worktree branch from main; write full 15-step plan to step_tracker.json.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify all five dependencies (t0024, t0080, t0093, t0102, t0104) are completed and write deps_report.json.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create mandatory task subfolders (assets/predictions, assets/answer, corrections, intervention, logs, plan, research, results/images, code) with .gitkeep markers.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review existing paper corpus for evidence on long-NSGA-II convergence behaviour, 2-direction DSI metrics, and hypervolume plateau diagnosis. Write research/research_papers.md.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search the internet for recent literature on long-horizon NSGA-II for biophysical neuron tuning, ratio-DSI usage in DSGC modelling, and pymoo HV convergence heuristics. Write research/research_internet.md.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Audit t0104's evaluator.py / nsga2_driver.py / constants_electrophys.py / mods/ to identify exact patch sites for the 2-direction + ratio-DSI + 300-gen + hourly HV log refit. Write research/research_code.md.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesise research outputs into plan/plan.md covering the t0104 evaluator fork, Vast.ai search criteria, hourly HV poll loop, operator stop mechanism, hard $25 cap, and per-cell cost envelope.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision one Vast.ai instance (EPYC class CPU, >= 100 GB RAM, RTX 3060 Ti / equivalent idle, reliability >= 0.99, dph <= 0.40) matching t0104's pattern; verify CPU model, RAM, Python, NEURON 8.2.7, pymoo, MOD compilation.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Smoke-test the patched evaluator locally; SCP code and t0080 mods to the instance; launch NSGA-II seed=44 pop=96 n_gen=300 n_eval_seeds=3 2-direction with hourly HV trace and operator-stop watcher; halt on intervention/stop.md or gen=300 or $20 watchdog.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Download per-generation HV trace, predictions cells, and final pickle to the worktree; destroy Vast.ai instance within 5 minutes of last completed generation; update machine_log.json, remote_machines_used.json, costs.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis: contrast HV plateau gen against t0102 / t0104; consider whether the 2-direction reformulation surfaces qualitatively new Pareto regions; flag any biological-plausibility anomalies in the high-DSI cells.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; generate HV-vs-gen, Pareto-front, joint-pass-tally, best-DSI lineage, anchor-distance histogram charts.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare t0106 best DSI / PD-rate / joint-pass tally against the t0080-t0104 lineage and against published DSGC tuning curves (de Rosenroll 2026, Poleg-Polsky & Diamond 2016). Write results/compare_literature.md.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Produce results/suggestions.json with concrete follow-ups (multi-seed confirmation, IBEA on 2-direction substrate, targeted morphology sweep around the best Pareto cell).

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all task / asset / log / machine verificators; capture session transcripts; mark task.json status completed; close out the step pipeline.
